{{Quote|I would not discount Omega's insight. A state of heightened awareness is not unusual for an enhanced clone such as herself.|Tech, in regards to Omega|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
'''Omega''' was an enhanced [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Cloning|clone]], created from the [[Clone template|genetic template]] of the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], who lived in the [[Standard year|years]] following the [[Clone Wars]]. Originally created as a pure genetic replication of Fett, she was a medical assistant to [[Kaminoan]] [[Chief Medical Scientist]] [[Nala Se]] and spent her [[Standard day|days]] working in [[Tipoca City]] on the clone [[Planet|homeworld]] of [[Kamino]]. Omega witnessed many clones, including [[Hunter]], [[Wrecker]], [[Tech]], [[Echo]], and [[Crosshair]] of [[Clone Force 99]], a [[squad]] of [[clone commando]]s with genetic mutations that were also known as the Bad Batch. When the war ended in [[19 BBY]], Clone Force 99 returned to Kamino from a [[Battle of Kaller|battle]] on the [[planet]] [[Kaller]] in the aftermath of [[Order 66]] and encountered the newly-created [[Galactic Empire]]. Omega recognized the squad and was determined to befriend them. Later, when [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] arrived on Kamino to assess the [[clone trooper]]s, Clone Force 99 rejected the Empire's new orders. Omega would join Clone Force 99 and escape Kamino, although Crosshair chose to stay behind and serve the new regime.

Omega accompanied Clone Force 99 on their subsequent visit to the clone deserter [[Cut Lawquane]] at his family's [[Lawquane's Farm|farm]] on the planet [[Saleucami]], which was her first time away from Kamino. There, she made friends with the Lawquane children, [[Shaeeah Lawquane|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane|Jek]], and helped secure the family's escape by delivering forged [[chain code]]s to them so they could board a [[transport]] offworld. Although Hunter wanted her to go along with the family on the [[Starship|ship]], wanting to Omega to grow up with a family instead of being looked after by a group of [[soldier]]s, Omega insisted on remaining with Clone Force 99.

After Omega drew the attention of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] during the Bad Batch's [[Chase on Pantora|supply run]] on the [[moon]] [[Pantora]], the group made their way to the planet [[Ord Mantell]] to locate the [[Information broker|informant]] named [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], a former associate of the [[Jedi]] during the war. The Bad Batch would begin working for Cid, first completing a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|mission]] on [[Ord Mantell]] in exchange for information on Shand as well as [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] before pulling a [[Mission to a droid decommissioning facility|job]] on the planet [[Corellia]]. Shortly after the latter mission, Omega met [[Captain]] [[Rex]], a former soldier in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and associate of the Bad Batch. When Rex realized that the group still had their [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]], he implored them to get them removed. Omega and the others would join him on the planet [[Bracca]] so the rest of the group could undergo a procedure inside a downed [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and get the chips removed. After Rex departed, the Batch was discovered by the Empire. After being pursued by Crosshair and his [[Elite Squad|forces]], Omega was eventually kidnapped by a third party: the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]]. She would eventually escape Bane when he landed at a [[Bora Vio cloning facility|cloning facility]] on the planet [[Bora Vio]] to collect his payment, and after evading Bane and the recently arrived Shand, she was rescued by the other members of the Bad Batch.

When Hunter was captured by the Empire on a [[Extraction on Daro|mission]] on the planet [[Daro]], Omega and the others returned to Kamino to rescue him. Omega assisted in freeing him from Crosshair and his squad, but when the Batch tried to flee, [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyers]] [[Attack on Kamino|bombarded]] Tipoca City, completely destroying it. The group, along with the [[medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]] and Crosshair, followed Omega through the [[Kamino tube system]] back to their [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|ship]], but when the elevator back to the [[secret landing platform]] was damaged, the group floated to the surface in cloning pods, guided through the debris by AZI-3. When the [[droid]] sacrificed the last of his power to save Omega, she dived into the [[water]] after him and nearly drowned before being saved by Crosshair. When the Batch offered Crosshair the chance to rejoin them and leave the Empire behind, he declined. Omega thanked him for saving her and reminded him that no matter what, he was still their brother as well as hers before leaving Kamino with her squad.

Omega would go on to become a skilled user of the [[Zygerrian energy bow]] and would accompany the Bad Batch on many jobs and adventures, including on the planets [[Serenno]], [[Serolonis]], [[Skara Nal]], and [[Kashyyyk]]. She and the squad would visit the planet [[Coruscant]] when Rex asked them to help [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]], who was fighting for the rights of all clone troopers in the [[Galactic Senate]]. With their help, Chuchi was able to expose the destruction of Tipoca City as an Imperial deed, but it only amounted to [[Darth Sidious|the Emperor]] manipulating the Senate into allowing for new military measures that did not benefit the clones. Furthermore, Echo departed from the squad, joining Rex's [[Clone Underground]]. Omega tearfully said goodbye to Echo, although he promised he would not be gone forever. Omega struggled with Echo's absence, and when the ''Marauder'' was hijacked and stolen on the planet [[Ipsidon]], the squad's tight-knit togetherness was further threatened. Omega grew frustrated with her brothers and their willingness to move on and accept change, although after an important conversation with Tech, she realized that they were all dealing with it in their own way.

Having cut ties with Cid, who had neglected them in their time of need on Ipsidon, the Bad Batch would work with the [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]], and Omega took an interest in her outlandish tales of adventure. They would eventually visit the remote paradise of [[Pabu island|Pabu]], an island community that lay peacefully off the Empire's radar. Although Hunter wanted to stay on the island permanently and give Omega a peaceful life, they would learn that Crosshair had become an Imperial [[prisoner]] following Echo's return with the intel. Echo presented them with Imperial information as well as the group receiving a transmission from Crosshair, who had momentarily escaped and warned them that the Empire was still hunting them. In fact, Omega specifically was still a person of interest to Imperial researcher [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]], who wanted to capture her to force Nala Se into working for the Empire's [[Advanced Science Division]] project at [[Tantiss Base]].

The Batch made a plan to rescue Crosshair, traveling to the planet [[Eriadu]] to locate Hemlock there and use him to find Crosshair. However, the [[Bombing of Raven's Peak|mission]] proved disastrous, as they only escaped Imperial capture when Tech sacrificed himself and fell to his death. The whole squad was heartbroken, and Omega was devastated. Their return to Ord Mantell was equally calamitous, as Cid had sold them out to the Empire. Omega would be [[Capture of Omega|captured]] and taken to Mount Tantiss where she would meet another female clone named [[Emerie Karr]]. On Mount Tantiss, Omega would be imprisoned and forced to be a lab assistant to Karr and Nala Se. Although Nala Se tried to protect Omega from involvement in her research by destroying her blood samples, eventually, her blood was tested and identified as of critical use for the Empire's [[Project Necromancer]], causing the Kaminoan to facilitate Omega's escape. With the help of Nala Se's [[datapad]], Omega rescued Crosshair, who had also been imprisoned and tested on, and together, the two narrowly escaped [[Mount Tantiss]] and eventually reunited with the Bad Batch.

Omega was overjoyed to be reunited with her squad, and while Crosshair's return initially caused some friction, he was welcomed back as well. Soon after her return, Omega learned from intel gathered by Rex's Clone Underground that she was still one of the Empire's highest-priority targets and was being pursued by [[Clone X trooper]]s due to her [[Midi-chlorian|M-count]] levels, which had been determined through the blood testing. Omega was forced to lay low on Pabu while the others gathered information on why the Empire was so determined to find her. After Hunter and Wrecker did a mission with Fennec Shand in exchange for information about M-count, the former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]] found them on Pabu to pass along the information they had sought, which was that M-count targets were potentially strong with [[the Force]]. Despite the rest of the squad being distrusting of the former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] agent, Omega wanted to trust her and underwent several tests to see if she was in tune with the Force, as Ventress had suggested. However, the tests proved inconclusive.

After Ventress left Pabu, Hunter decided that Omega and the squad should leave the island, not wanting the Empire to also discover them there. However, it was too late. As they prepared to leave, an Imperial [[division]] arrived, destroying the ''Marauder'' and ransacking the town from the top down. As Omega and the others hid, Omega decided that she would have to turn herself over to the Empire to prevent any more harm to the civilians of Pabu. She surrendered to CX-2, with Crosshair being tasked with planting a tracker on the assassin's ship. However, he failed to do so, and Omega was brought back to Tantiss without knowing that her brothers had no way to find her. Back at Tantiss, Doctor Hemlock introduced her to the other subjects in their experiment, several [[Force-sensitive]] children who were being kept in the [[Tantiss vault]]. At the same time that her brothers began an attack on Tantiss in an effort to free her, Omega plotted her own escape alongside her fellow child [[prisoner]]s. After aiding in the escape of the children and other imprisoned clones, Omega was briefly recaptured by Hemlock, though he was [[Death|killed]] as Hunter and Crosshair rescued her. After the escape from Tantiss, Omega and the rest of Clone Force 99 returned to Pabu, where they continued to live for many [[Standard year|years]]. At some point, Omega set out to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[pilot]].
